query: What percentage of additional premium do individuals with serious pre-existing medical conditions need to pay for MediShield Life for the first 10 years?
answer: Without specific information, I can't give an exact percentage. However, according to the Singapore Health Insurance Scheme, individuals with serious pre-existing medical conditions may have to pay a higher premium for MediShield Life in the first 10 years, typically around 50% to 100% more than others.
